lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high overall, though select winning tests (such as sign_in redesign in round 6 and choose_path redesign in round 10) were underpredicted.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful and consistently positive across 6 tests, winning 2 tests.
Home wait_info changes (5 tests) and adoption layout changes (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Finish redesign changes (4 tests) and finish new_screen changes (3 tests) showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Adoption redesign changes (3 tests) showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for categories with few tests or conflicting outcomes (including home notification, choose_path layout, and sign_in redesign).

candidates.title: Compact Layout Pick Friend Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet choice interface to use a compact layout so users can view available pets simultaneously without scrolling.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a significant drop-off (60.9% conversion) and takes a long median time of 89s. A compact layout simplifies comparison.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Pet
pick_friend.body: Select a desktop companion to begin your onboarding journey.

guard.reason: Compact layout for pet selection keeps all functionality intact within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off, but historical adoption redesigns consistently show negative or negligible results.

candidates.title: Pet Companion Overview Welcome Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated overview screen right before pet selection detailing companion interaction styles.
candidates.why: Users take median 89s in adoption and support receives queries regarding how desktop pets behave and interact.

new_pet_overview.headline: Meet Your Future Desktop Pet
new_pet_overview.body: Your companion lives on your screen, reacts to your activity, and offers daily encouragement.

guard.reason: Adding a new introductory pet overview screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Support mail aligns with confusion, but adding screens to adoption historically hurts conversion significantly.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Controls Onboarding Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive setup flow screen right before home intro explaining mouse shortcuts, dock position, and hide toggles.
candidates.why: Support logged multiple emails complaining about unclear controls for hiding or talking to the pet post-onboarding, and finish conversion drops to 68.0%.

new_desktop_controls_flow.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_desktop_controls_flow.body: Click to talk, right-click for quick settings, or drag to reposition your pet anywhere on your screen.

guard.reason: Adding a new desktop controls tutorial screen before home intro is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between support tickets and finish drop-off, but adding new onboarding screens in finish usually degrades conversion.

candidates.title: Card Layout Story Intro Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story introduction screen using a clean card layout to clearly present the app's core value upfront.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean time of 514s; presenting a structured card layout reduces decision friction.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Choose how you want your pet companion to fit into your daily desktop workflow.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while preserving its core introductory job is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path drop-off is minor; redesigns here have shown small positive gains (+2.0% overall).

candidates.title: Sign In Pet Save Protection Hint
candidates.change: Display an inline hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in links and preserves pet data across restarts.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again. Sign-in hints have proven effective in previous rounds.

sign_in.hint: Signing in links your desktop pet to your account so progress is never lost.

guard.reason: Adding a sign-in reassurance hint is a valid onboarding enhancement.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail alignment (8 tickets) and sign-in hints consistently perform well across previous rounds.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Alert System Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification triggers on the waiting screen to alert users when the pet finishes rendering and appears on screen.
candidates.why: Support noted 3 issues where pets failed to show or users thought the app stalled. Waiting step median time is 201s.

waiting.hint: We will alert you as soon as your desktop companion completes spawning.

guard.reason: Adding a completion notification toggle on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses reported user stalling, but home notification tests have shown 0.0% lift across 5 previous tests.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Interaction Copy Update
candidates.change: Update the final welcome headline and body text to give explicit instructions on interacting with and hiding the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to pets after completing setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Left-click your pet to open interactions, or right-click to hide or adjust desktop companion settings.

guard.reason: Updating text copy on the home intro screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low cost text update backed by 3 tickets, but copy changes in finish step have not shown positive returns.

candidates.title: Choose Path Starter Bonus Badge
candidates.change: Add an highlighted starter perk badge component to the path selection screen.
candidates.why: 13.9% of starting users drop off on path selection, taking a mean of 514s.

guard.reason: Rule 3 prohibits onboarding copy from mentioning starter bonuses, gifts, perks, or free extras.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Step Progress Timer Display
candidates.change: Display active step counters and estimated remaining time on the waiting screen while desktop assets compile.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has a high mean time of 2336s (median 201s), leading to user drop-off during background loading.

guard.reason: Displaying progress counters and time estimates for an actual asset rendering wait is allowed under Rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Addresses wait time, but 5 previous home wait_info tests consistently showed virtually no effect (+0.3%).

candidates.title: Compact Split Path Selection Layout
candidates.change: Switch the choose_path screen layout to compact view to highlight companion paths efficiently.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean 514s; presenting path options in a compact layout improves evaluation speed.

guard.reason: Changing the layout and headline of the path selection screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Target step loss is small; choose_path layout changes have shown slight positive lift (+1.0%).
